_readme: Minimal two-seat roster: one provider (OpenRouter), one API key, two model families, so the consensus table can count two independent lineages. Use it with PANEL_SEATS=examples/seats.openrouter-two-seat.json. The key is read from the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable and never written anywhere. Both model ids were listed by https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on 2026-11-14; replace them with current ids from that list when they change, and keep each seat's lineage equal to the lab that trained the model.
